chart.note_rule: Be verb negative: I am not (= I'm not). General verb negative: I do not (= I don't).
chart.note_exception: There is NO 'I amn't'. Always use I'm not for be verb negatives.
chart.note_exception_detail: I'm not a fan. ✅　　I amn't a fan. ❌

stem: I am a soccer fan. → Negative?
answers: I am not a soccer fan.
I not am a soccer fan.

explanation.title: I am not
explanation.body: Be verb negative: add 'not' after 'am'. I am not a soccer fan.

explanation.title: I don't + verb
explanation.body: General verb negative: I do not (= I don't) + verb. I don't like music.

stem: Which is the correct SHORT form of 'I am not'?

explanation.title: I'm not
explanation.body: I am not → I'm not. There is NO 'amn't' in English!

explanation.title: I'm not + noun
explanation.body: For be verb negatives with nouns: I'm not + noun.
